name: Erev Shabbat Countdown - two weeks in Jerusalem

turns.text: I live in Jerusalem, I want to be ready 10 minutes before candle lighting. On Fridays I start at 12:00. Thursday night I'm free 20:00-00:00.

Add my tasks. 1) shopping: 50 min, active, must, no dependencies, not heavy, cannot move to Thursday. 2) challah: 60 min, active, must, no dependencies, not heavy, cannot move to Thursday. 3) challah_rise: 45 min, passive, must, depends on challah, cannot move to Thursday. 4) challah_bake: 30 min, passive, must, depends on challah_rise, cannot move to Thursday. 5) cooking: 15 min, active, must, depends on shopping, tag dinner, not heavy, can move to Thursday. 6) slow_cook: 150 min, passive, must, depends on cooking, tag dinner, cannot move to Thursday. 7) cleaning: 50 min, active, must, no dependencies, heavy, can move to Thursday. 8) set_table: 15 min, active, must, no dependencies, must end by 15:00, cannot move to Thursday. 9) flowers: 15 min, active, nice-to-have, no dependencies, cannot move to Thursday. 10) shower: 20 min, active, must, no dependencies, always the last task before the checklist, cannot move to Thursday.
My last-minute checklist: turn off the phone 2 min, set the alarm 2 min, turn on the hot plate 3 min, set the light timers 3 min.
Weekly review: challah took 90 minutes, cleaning only 40.
Yes, move cleaning to Thursday night. And this week we're guests Friday night, no dinner cooking.
